Title: GDBMedChem similarity search
Description: Returns the 100 nearest neighbours of a query from GDBMedChem, a ten-million-molecule collection distilled from the 166 billion structures of GDB17 by removing problematic functional groups and overly complex scaffolds. Awale and colleagues sampled the remainder evenly across size, stereochemistry and polarity, producing a set with better synthetic accessibility than GDB17 while retaining higher sp3 character and natural product likeness than typical drugs. Neighbours are enumerated rather than catalogued compounds.
Interpretation: List of the 100 nearest neighbours to the query molecule in the GDBMedChem library.
